audit.whatIsWrong: Four of seven full-layer chart rows disagreed with the content layer and the packet chart (phases[0],[1] read 'Skill' vs 'Anivia'; phases[5] 'Skill' vs 'Anivia'; phases[6] 'Veigar' vs 'Anivia').
audit.why: The page rendered two different answers to who wins Level 1, Level 2, First item and Two+ items — and the 2+ items row said the opposite champion outright.
audit.corrected: Full layer aligned to win[] and packet.levelChart; levels 3 and 4-5 correctly stay 'Skill' on both layers.

audit.whatIsWrong: No line anywhere gives Event Horizon's cooldown, which is the entire tempo of the lane.
audit.why: Event Horizon is 20s at rank 1 and only 14s maxed. That is an enormous punish window against a champion whose damage stalls without it, and the reader was told to 'count it' with no number to count to.
audit.corrected: 20s written into the cooldown line, the do's and the win condition.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two decisive interactions were absent: Primordial Burst's missing-health scaling against Rebirth, and Baleful Strike hitting two targets.
audit.why: Primordial Burst (120/90/60s, 650) increases with the target's MISSING health, so a fresh hatch at full health is its weakest moment. Baleful Strike (6s at rank 1, 1000) damages the first TWO enemies hit, so standing directly behind a minion does not screen you — and every minion it kills is permanent AP via Phenomenal Evil.
audit.corrected: Both stated; the wave-denial argument now has a reason behind it.

edits.before: - Veigar Event Horizon (Cage): matchup-defining — Only the cage EDGE stuns — hold position near the center or leave before it forms; never dash into the wall. Step up only on its downtime. - Budget W Crystallize for emergencies and the R for opportunities — never swap them.
edits.after: - Event Horizon is 20s at rank 1: only the cage EDGE stuns, so stand near the centre or leave before it forms. Twenty seconds is a long free window — spend it walking forward. - Primordial Burst grows with your missing health, so a fresh hatch blunts it.

edits.before: Make him kill you twice through a stun and a wall — then storm the wave he stopped farming. Nothing here works through Event Horizon (Cage) — schedule your pattern around its cooldown.
edits.after: Make him kill you twice through a stun and a wall — then storm the wave he stopped farming. Event Horizon is 20 seconds at rank 1, and every one of those seconds is a step forward you are allowed to take.

edits.before: Veigar wins by landing Event Horizon (Cage), denying your pattern, and keeping the fight at a distance your kit resents.
edits.after: Veigar wins by catching you on the cage edge, dropping Dark Matter on the hold, and finishing with a missing-health Primordial Burst.

edits.before: Threaten Q until Veigar burns his sidestep tool, land it, then E + auto and walk before the answer — chilled E double-damage is the whole trade.
edits.after: Poke while Event Horizon sits on its 20 seconds: Flash Frost for the chill, E for double damage, and step out before Dark Matter lands on you.

edits.before: Spamming Q on cooldown until you are out of mana with no stun threat left — that is when Veigar walks straight at you.
edits.after: Last-hitting in a straight line behind one minion — Baleful Strike damages the first two targets, so that minion screens nothing.

edits.before: If Veigar opens the score, reset expectations and respect Event Horizon (Cage) doubly. After a second, your job description changes — farm with R wave-clear and stay relevant through zone control.
edits.after: If Veigar opens the score, his Phenomenal Evil stacks make every later trade worse — deny him the wave rather than the duel. After a second, farm with R wave-clear and stay relevant through zone control.

edits.before: Carry by controlling space — storm and wall decide where fights happen, and your stun decides who dies first inside them.
edits.after: Carry by refusing the cage: hold the choke with storm, and a wall on his Event Horizon line leaves him nothing to trap you against.

edits.before: Only the cage EDGE stuns — hold position near the center or leave before it forms; never dash into the wall. Bait it, count it, then go.
edits.after: Only the cage EDGE stuns: if it lands around you, walk to the middle and wait it out rather than sprinting through the wall.

edits.before: Threaten Q until Veigar burns his sidestep tool, land it, then E + auto and walk before the answer — chilled E double-damage is the whole trade.
edits.after: Primordial Burst grows with the health you are missing, so hatching back at full health is the worst possible moment for him to cast it.

edits.before: Veigar burns Event Horizon (Cage) on nothing — take the fifteen-second invitation.
edits.after: A whiffed Event Horizon leaves him 20 seconds with no lockdown whatsoever.

edits.before: That’s Veigar’s bread-and-butter play — deny it and they run out of answers.
edits.after: Primordial Burst reads missing health — half HP is when he wants you.

edits.before: Your wall is your Flash — a wasted Crystallize means the next gank kills the bird AND the egg.
edits.after: Every minion Baleful Strike kills is permanent AP for him — contest the wave, do not concede it.

edits.before: Spamming Q on cooldown until you are out of mana with no stun threat left — that is when Veigar walks straight at you.
edits.after: Away from tower his cage and Dark Matter have time to land twice, and the egg only buys you one of them.

edits.before: Play slightly loose only once you have flash/ignite advantage on cooldowns
edits.after: Play loose only while Event Horizon is down — 20 seconds at rank 1

notes: The kit file lists Dark Matter's cooldown as '0' (Phenomenal Evil stacks reduce it), so no W cooldown number is asserted anywhere in these edits. Level chart: phases[6].side said 'Veigar' while win[6] said 'Anivia' — an outright contradiction on the final row; fixed on the full layer, which is the side that disagreed with both the content layer and the packet. Levels 3 and 4-5 legitimately read 'Skill' on both layers and were left alone. The content layer here is already specific and needed only one edit.
